columns.description: System auto-generated identifier in the format BGT-00001. Read-only; stamped on Add only, so the field is blank until the user starts a new record.
Free-text department name. The application has no Department master today, so this is entered manually and is not validated against another table.
Spending limit tier for this department (e.g. Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3).
Active or Inactive. No default is pre-populated - the screen opens blank and Finance selects the value. Setting the tier Inactive locks the Budget Utilized and Budget Policy Document fields.

Uploaded document recording this tier's spending limit and monthly/quarterly budget cap values. Finance uploads, views and removes it; Employees view/download the same current file read-only. Stores the uploaded file URL.
Budget utilization entered manually by Finance (expenses are tracked by Employee, not by Department, so this is not auto-calculated).
User who created the budget policy tier (stamped on create).
Date and time the budget policy tier was created (stamped on create).
Audit: user who inserted the record.
Audit: terminal the record was inserted from.
Audit: user who last updated the record.
Audit: terminal of the last update.
